a_doped.source: Part A, alpha from 125 dB/cm, L = 39.6 um (notes 28)

fsr_nm.source: Part A SAX dip spacing at 1310 nm; analytic lambda^2/(n_g L) = 10.318

fwhm_pm.source: Part A SAX half-depth width; analytic (1-ta)lambda^2/(pi n_g L sqrt(ta)) = 373.2

t_min_critical.source: Part A, t = a = 0.945 (critical coupling): T_min = ((t-a)/(1-ta))^2 = 0

dT_per_0p1K_at_bias.unit: transmission change per 0.1 K at delta_opt
dT_per_0p1K_at_bias.source: Part A slope of T(lambda_L) vs temperature at +108 pm

neff_2d.source: Part B Meep eigenmode of the 2-D 500 nm guide (Ez); the textbook 2.5 is the 3-D strip: they are not expected to agree

ng_2d.source: Part B Meep eigenmode group velocity; textbook 4.2 is the 3-D strip

loss_calibrated_db_cm.source: Part B straight lossy guide, flux ratio over 8 um

a_fdtd_from_notch.source: Part B inverted from the notch depth and width of the FDTD spectrum vs the straight-guide calibration alone

a_fdtd_vs_calibrated_plus_excess.source: Part B same, vs a_calibrated x a_excess where a_excess = 0.9901 (0.087 dB/lap of radiation + coupler-junction + grid loss measured on the lossless ring at the same gap)

t_min_fdtd_vs_excess.source: Part B notch depth vs ((t-a)/(1-ta))^2 with the first-pass t and a = a_calibrated x a_excess

fsr_nm_fdtd.source: Part B flux-dip spacing vs lambda^2/(n_g L) with the straight-guide 2-D n_g and L = 2 pi R

fsr_nm_fdtd_bend_corrected.source: Part B same, with L_eff = 2 pi r_mean of the bent mode (r_mean = 6.34 um)

q_fdtd_flux.source: Part B lambda/FWHM of the flux notch vs Harminv Q

q_fdtd_pred.source: Part B flux Q vs all-pass formula with t from the lossless gap scan and a from the loss calibration

t_min_fdtd.source: Part B notch depth vs ((t-a)/(1-ta))^2 with the same t and a

kappa2_fdtd_gap100nm.source: Part B 2-D coupling at a 100 nm gap vs the reference device's 0.107: under-coupled in 2-D

gap_for_critical_um.source: Part B extrapolated lossless gap scan to kappa^2 = 1 - a^2

q_buildup.source: Part B CW build-up time constant tau = 2Q/omega fitted to the ring energy

buildup_tau_ps.source: Part B amplitude build-up time constant

field_enhancement_fdtd.source: Part B steady-state CW field ratio vs (1-t^2)/(1-ta)^2 (rough: single-component field ratio)
